# has attestation

Relates an entity to an attestation about it — the inverse of gmeow:attestedSubject. Non-functional: an entity may have many co-existing attestations from different attesters (Principle 9).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAttestation>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasAttestation`  

*object property* · domain `gmeow:Entity` · range `gmeow:Attestation`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/attestation>
